cross_object_rules.meaning: Risk affects a decision and must be visible in reasoning.
A blocker should create or select an action to clear it.
An opportunity creates action only when supported by evidence.
A relationship can anchor missions, actions, evidence, proof, and learning.
A capability is available only inside permitted workspace boundaries.
Every object must inherit workspace context before cross-workspace features activate.

rules: No action can establish its own authority.
Caller-supplied status or approval cannot make an action valid.
Write-capable actions require explicit authority and audit.
Read-only actions may still require visibility checks.
Actions must never hide evidence gaps.
Decisions must cite evidence or explicitly record missing evidence.
Decisions must distinguish recommendation from approval.
Decisions must preserve alternatives when alternatives affected priority.
Durable authority is required before decisions mutate state.
